verses.original: וַ֠יָּשָׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֧ה אֶל־ בֵּית֛וֹ בְּשָׁל֖וֹם לִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’el- bê·ṯōw bə·šā·lō·wm lî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah had returned safely to his home in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Josafá, rei de Judá, voltou em paz para sua casa, em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א אֶל־ פָּנָ֗יו יֵה֣וּא בֶן־ חֲנָ֘נִי֮ הַחֹזֶה֒ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הֲלָרָשָׁ֣ע לַעְזֹ֔ר וּלְשֹׂנְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תֶּאֱהָ֑ב וּבָזֹאת֙ עָלֶ֣יךָ קֶּ֔צֶף מִלִּפְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’el- pā·nāw yê·hū ḇen- ḥă·nā·nî ha·ḥō·zeh way·yō·mer ’el- ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ hă·lā·rā·šā‘ la‘·zōr ū·lə·śō·nə·’ê Yah·weh te·’ĕ·hāḇ ū·ḇā·zōṯ ‘ā·le·ḵā qe·ṣep̄ mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him and said to King Jehoshaphat Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD Because of this the wrath of the LORD is upon you
verses.literalPt: Jeú, filho de Hanani, o vidente, saiu-lhe ao encontro e disse ao rei Josafá: Deves tu socorrer aos iníquos e amar os que aborrecem a Jeová? Por isso, veio sobre ti grande ira da parte de Jeová.

verses.original: אֲבָ֕ל דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִ֖ים נִמְצְא֣וּ עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ בִעַ֤רְתָּ הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַהֲכִינ֥וֹתָ לְבָבְךָ֖ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇāl də·ḇā·rîm ṭō·w·ḇîm nim·ṣə·’ū ‘im·māḵ kî- ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·’ă·šê·rō·wṯ min- hā·’ā·reṣ wa·hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯā lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā liḏ·rōš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: However some good is found in you for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God
verses.literalPt: Contudo, em ti se acharam boas coisas, porque tiraste para fora da terra as Aserotes, e dispuseste o teu coração a buscar a Deus.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑םס וַיָּ֜שָׁב וַיֵּצֵ֣א בָעָ֗ם מִבְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֙בַע֙ עַד־ הַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַיְשִׁיבֵ֕ם אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ bī·rū·šå̄·lå̄·ms way·yā·šāḇ way·yê·ṣê ḇā·‘ām mib·bə·’êr še·ḇa‘ ‘aḏ- har ’ep̄·ra·yim way·šî·ḇêm ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem and once again he went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD the God of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Habitou Josafá em Jerusalém; tornou a passar pelo povo desde Berseba até a região montanhosa de Efraim e fez que ele tornasse a Jeová, Deus de seus pais.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֨ד שֹֽׁפְטִ֜ים בָּאָ֗רֶץ בְּכָל־ עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַבְּצֻר֖וֹת לְעִ֥יר וָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ šō·p̄ə·ṭîm bā·’ā·reṣ bə·ḵāl ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ lə·‘îr wā·‘îr
verses.literal: He appointed judges in the land in each of the fortified cities of Judah
verses.literalPt: Estabeleceu juízes em todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá, de cidade em cidade.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ הַשֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים רְאוּ֙ מָֽה־ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כִּ֣י לֹ֧א לְאָדָ֛ם תִּשְׁפְּט֖וּ כִּ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וְעִמָּכֶ֖ם בִּדְבַ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- haš·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm rə·’ū māh- ’at·tem ‘ō·śîm kî lō lə·’ā·ḏām tiš·pə·ṭū kî Yah·weh wə·‘im·mā·ḵem biḏ·ḇar miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Then he said to the judges Consider carefully what you do for you are not judging for man but for the LORD who is with you when you render judgment
verses.literalPt: Disse aos juízes: Vede o que fazeis, pois não julgais da parte do homem, mas da parte de Jeová. Em julgardes, ele está convosco.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהִ֥י פַֽחַד־ יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שִׁמְר֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ כִּֽי־ אֵ֞ין עִם־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַוְלָ֛ה וּמַשֹּׂ֥א פָנִ֖ים וּמִקַּח־ שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yə·hî p̄a·ḥaḏ- Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem šim·rū wa·‘ă·śū kî- ’ên ‘im- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘aw·lāh ū·maś·śō p̄ā·nîm ū·miq·qaḥ- šō·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: And now may the fear of the LORD be upon you Be careful what you do for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality . . . or bribery . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, seja o temor de Jeová sobre vós; tomai cuidado e fazei-o, porque não há, em Jeová, nosso Deus, iniquidade, nem acepção de pessoas, nem aceitação de dádivas.

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם בִּ֠ירוּשָׁלִַם הֶעֱמִ֨יד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּמֵרָאשֵׁ֤י הָאָבוֹת֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה וְלָרִ֑יב וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam bî·rū·šā·lim he·‘ĕ·mîḏ yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ min- hal·wî·yim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm ū·mê·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·miš·paṭ Yah·weh wə·lā·rîḇ way·yā·šu·ḇū yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Moreover Jehoshaphat appointed in Jerusalem some of the Levites priests and heads of the Israelite families to judge on behalf of the LORD and to settle disputes And they lived in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Também estabeleceu Josafá, em Jerusalém, alguns dos levitas, e dos sacerdotes, e dos cabeças das famílias de Israel, para julgarem da parte de Jeová e para decidirem as controvérsias. E voltaram para Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ו עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּן֙ בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בֶּאֱמוּנָ֖ה וּבְלֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ‘ă·lê·hem lê·mōr kōh ṯa·‘ă·śūn bə·yir·’aṯ Yah·weh be·’ĕ·mū·nāh ū·ḇə·lê·ḇāḇ šā·lêm
verses.literal: He commanded them . . . saying . . . You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly . . . in the fear of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Ordenou-lhes, dizendo: Assim procedereis no temor de Jeová, com fidelidade e com um coração perfeito.

verses.original: וְכָל־ רִיב֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יָב֨וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם מֵאֲחֵיכֶ֣ם׀ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֗ם בֵּֽין־ דָּ֣ם׀ לְדָם֮ בֵּין־ תּוֹרָ֣ה לְמִצְוָה֮ לְחֻקִּ֣ים וּלְמִשְׁפָּטִים֒ וְהִזְהַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֤א יֶאְשְׁמוּ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה־ קֶ֥צֶף עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְעַל־ אֲחֵיכֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשׂ֖וּן וְלֹ֥א תֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl rîḇ ’ă·šer- yā·ḇō·w ‘ă·lê·ḵem mê·’ă·ḥê·ḵem hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·‘ā·rê·hem bên- dām lə·ḏām bên- tō·w·rāh lə·miṣ·wāh lə·ḥuq·qîm ū·lə·miš·pā·ṭîm wə·hiz·har·tem ’ō·ṯām wə·lō ye’·šə·mū Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh- qe·ṣep̄ ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·‘al- ’ă·ḥê·ḵem kōh ṯa·‘ă·śūn wə·lō ṯe’·šā·mū
verses.literal: For every dispute that comes before you from your brothers who dwell in their cities whether it regards bloodshed or some other violation of law commandments statutes or ordinances you are to warn them so that they will not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath will not come upon you and your brothers Do this and you will not incur guilt
verses.literalPt: Todas as vezes que vos submeterem alguma controvérsia de vossos irmãos que habitam nas cidades, entre sangue e sangue, entre lei e mandamento, estatutos e juízos, admoestá-los-eis, para que não sejam culpados para com Jeová, e deste modo venha a ira sobre vós e sobre vossos irmãos. Fazei isso e não sereis culpados.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֡ה אֲמַרְיָ֣הוּ כֹהֵן֩ הָרֹ֨אשׁ עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה וּזְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל הַנָּגִ֤יד לְבֵית־ יְהוּדָה֙ לְכֹ֣ל דְּבַר־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְשֹׁטְרִ֥ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם חִזְק֣וּ וַעֲשׂ֔וּ וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם־ הַטּֽוֹב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’ă·mar·yā·hū ḵō·hên hā·rōš ‘ă·lê·ḵem lə·ḵōl də·ḇar- Yah·weh ū·zə·ḇaḏ·yā·hū ḇen- yiš·mā·‘êl han·nā·ḡîḏ lə·ḇêṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ḵōl də·ḇar- ham·me·leḵ wə·šō·ṭə·rîm hal·wî·yim lip̄·nê·ḵem ḥiz·qū wa·‘ă·śū wî·hî Yah·weh ‘im- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Note that Amariah the chief priest will be over you in all that pertains to the LORD and Zebadiah son of Ishmael the ruler of the house of Judah in all that pertains to the king And the Levites will serve as officers before you Act resolutely may the LORD be with the upright
verses.literalPt: Eis que o sumo sacerdote Amarias está sobre vós em todos os negócios de Jeová; e Zebadias, filho de Ismael, príncipe da casa de Judá, em todos os negócios do rei. Também os levitas serão oficiais diante de vós. Procedei corajosamente, e seja Jeová com os bons.
